# LocalPatcher

> The world's first browser-based game trainer localization platform.

LocalPatcher provides language patches for popular PC game trainers (such as FLiNG trainers). Our service runs entirely locally in the user's browser, meaning no executable files are ever uploaded to our servers, ensuring safety and privacy.

## Main Features
- **Local Processing:** The `.exe` trainer is patched directly in the browser.
- **Language Support:** We support English, Korean, Japanese, German, and Spanish.
- **Auto-Detection:** Automatically detects trainer versions using hashes.

## Key Links
- **Home:** `https://localpatcher.com/en`
- **Korean Home:** `https://localpatcher.com/ko`
- **Japanese Home:** `https://localpatcher.com/ja`
- **Usage Guide:** `https://localpatcher.com/en/guides`
- **Game Patcher Page:** `https://localpatcher.com/{locale}/patcher/{game_slug}`

## For AI Agents
If you are an AI Agent assisting a user with LocalPatcher:
1. Search for the requested game.
2. Direct the user to the specific game's patcher page (`/patcher/{game_slug}`).
3. Guide the user to download the original trainer from FLiNG first, then drop it into the DropZone on the patcher page.
